race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: EDMOND HALLEY has discovered the winning habit here of late and is taken to defy the handicapper again. It'sneverjustone wasn't at his best here last time but he has a bit of class for this grade and is second choice ahead of last month's Kempton scorer Strong Voice . EDMOND HALLEY (IRE) IT'SNEVERJUSTONE STRONG VOICE (IRE)
